title: GDD T-116 — Telemetría: buffer local SQLite + eventos del apéndice C (§15)
description: Telemetry pipeline per GDD §15 and Appendix C. Core emits engine-free event POCOs (session_start/end, mg_result, mech_winrate_asym, board_action, bonus_star_flip, idle_seat, crash/watchdog with replayRef) sharing the common header {cabinetId, contentVersion, sessionId, ts, tick}; Framework owns transport: local SQLite buffer, batch send as JSON Lines (compressed) when network is available, 30-day local retention, nothing lost offline. In-session counters that feed the bonus-star pool (§6.3: eliminations, weapons used, latency averages, coins deposited, coins stolen) are part of this event stream so ScoreModel and telemetry read one source of truth. Privacy: no personal data, ever — anonymous per-session game events only. Crash events attach the replay file reference (.bcrp from the T-115 ticket). Read GDD §15 + Appendix C + §6.3 counters before coding.
acceptance_criteria: All Appendix C events implemented as engine-free Core POCOs with the common header; emission points wired through the session flow (unit tests per event type)
SQLite local buffer with batch flush, offline-safe (no event loss without network), 30-day retention with pruning; transport format JSON Lines compressed per batch
Session counters for the 6.3 bonus-star criteria are tracked and queryable at Game Over
No personally identifying data in any event (schema audit test enumerating fields)
Buffer/rotation/flush logic covered by regression tests; integration smoke proves a full simulated session produces the expected event sequence
Fast suite and existing tests stay green

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: [RE-APPLIED] Calibration-risk note from the TASK-037 review (rev-c037 LOW-2, 2026-07-07): nothing at runtime enforces the GDD 5.6 economy envelope (sinks absorbing ~70% of ~35-coin income). The scoring layer's 'wager swings ~1 star' property holds ONLY inside that envelope — if the live economy drifts, the property silently degrades and comebacks inflate past design intent. When this telemetry ticket lands, include per-session coin-flow metrics (income, sink absorption rate, wager swing in star-equivalents) so envelope drift is observable in pilot data.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CARRY-IN from TASK-051 (rev-t051 LOW-1, disposition: documented not normalized): SessionCounters' Reacciona/Gatillo latency feed stores the CUMULATIVE tick-latency across all tandas converted to ms — including Reacciona's 1,000,000-tick failure sentinel (~16.7M "ms") for false starts/DNFs. Ordering across seats is correct (WinnerOf sound; same tanda count for all active seats per round), but the stored mean is NOT a genuine per-tanda latency. When implementing GDD §15 telemetry (mg_result: latencias) or any HUD display of latency, normalize at the source: per-tanda normalization needs the tanda count (ReaccionaParams.Rounds), which the IMicrogame/MicrogameResult contract does not currently expose (PlayerRank.Metric is a bare cumulative value) — extending MicrogameResult/PlayerRank or having the mechanic self-normalize is this ticket's design decision to make. Feed-site doc comment landed in TASK-051 fix commit ba124c1.
